property_summary: A call to go() reverts if and only if the forwarded value to the hardcoded target is rejected, and when it reverts, c's balance is at least its pre-call balance (the rejected value may or may not be returned to c); when it does not revert, c's balance is zero (all remaining Ether sent to owner).

confirmed_difference.thread_focus: whether a call `go(args)` reverts or completes, and on which inputs
